Of Misery

Thomas Howell (fl. 1568)

C
ORPSE,
 clad with carefulness;
Heart, heaped with heaviness;
Purse, poor and penniless;
Back bare in bitterness;
O get my grave in readiness;
Fain would I die to end this stress.
